s: a million in currency (euros, dollars etc.)
a very large sum of money
Mio.et: Spelling pronunciation of the abbreviation Mio or Mio.. See Etymology 1.

s: Miocene (The first geological epoch of the Neogene Period that extends from about 23.03 to 5.333 million years ago.)
das Miozän ist der ältere Abschnitt des Neogens
Miozän.et:
From older Miocän, borrowed from English Miocene.
Ultimately from Ancient Greek μείων (meíōn, “less; smaller”) and Ancient Greek καινός (kainós, “fresh, new”)
